# LoCoMo

*Generated by `scripts/gen_bench_pages.py` from the `oml-bench/1` results in `eval/bench/results/`; do not edit by hand. Regenerate with `python scripts/gen_bench_pages.py`, and CI fails when this page differs from what it writes.*

Suite `locomo`, data `locomo10.json sha256:79fa87e90f040813`: 5,882 memories, 1,535 queries; a method marked sampled asked a seeded subset, named in its row. Measured 2026-11-05 on commit `9a4bae6`, `d3fdb72`; build release, host 8 vCPU / 15 GB, postgres 17.9.

## Limits of this run

- Offline bm25s over the same memories (Lucene BM25, English stop words, Snowball stems), not a served path; One dialogue turn per memory, each conversation its own workarea; metrics over categories 1-4, adversarial in per_category; English only.
- One dialogue turn per memory, each conversation its own workarea; metrics over categories 1-4, adversarial in per_category; English only.
